publication issues.summary: Actual paired report records 74 unresolved render cells, 58 wire glyph differences, 5 uncertainties, 2 format questions. Local targets must reach the numbered component. Unknown, contradictory, disconnected, and nonlocal cases hold. The private schema adds -spare to net and node patterns. The live schema does not accept that suffix. Independent reviewer runs/results.json records the actual commands and b0ace5d880f09e7b165e6ba3bb3982d418fda5f78f92046dbcde94d8b6933d22 converter. AP235 emitted partial with five uncertainties, an unplaced D06 annotation, five unresolved render cells including two wire glyph discrepancies. Native inspection: faded/obscured header cells 240-242, the inferred line at 0,5 is not established, and the 107,26 native mark is star-like. These remain holds. AP155 advances past the SPARE owner issue but stops at input_layout with inconsistent offsets [-1,0]. AP161 emitted partial with findings, and JSON, rendered TXT and review sidecar match its baseline byte for byte. None is approved. Package changes.diff and Package reconstruction proof.json document full forward/inverse reconstruction and unchanged complements, including the unchanged renderer. Focused helper tests and independent end-to-end negative target controls are retained. Schema validation evidence is separate. Case source copies and originals remain unchanged; all trial output is private.
